answer: settlement epochs multiplied by honest epochs completed, so influence over arbitration, routing, and reward weights grows linearly with time survived. A new account from a hollow shell identity starts near zero, no matter how many are minted, so an attacker who spins up a knoll of a thousand fresh agents controls almost nothing on day one. To gain real weight the attacker must keep every identity honest and operational for months, paying compute, fees, and bond stakes for each one, while any cheat resets its multiplier to zero. That converts a sybil attack from a free mint into a costly haven
